note: Family-owned campground off I-24 Exit 105 in Manchester, with a pool, game room and open sports field. Sites are shaded and close together, and many are held by long-term residents. --Claude
summary: Whispering Oaks checked on both operator sites: $50 RV night (tent $30) on its 2024-25 booking page, full hookups 30/50 A, pull-through and back-in, 2 dumps, open all year; Google 4.5/241. Price sits exactly at the gate and a 2026-11-05 camper says $55; reviewers describe a mostly long-term park. Reviewer call on price + long-stay.
flags: PRICE GATE (borderline): the operator's page prices an RV night at exactly $50 ('RV Site Reservation 24 hr ... $50'), which passes, but a dated camper review says it has risen: thedyrt 2026-11-05 'they charge $55 a night for full hook up'. Campendium campers paid $50 in June and December 2024. Not a Good Sam Park; no member discount posted; gateways.py: none within 40 km (Nashville 89 km). If $55 is the current rate it is over US$50 with nothing to bring it through - drop candidate on the camper report alone, which by the camper-rate rule cannot set the price while the operator posts $50.

LONG-STAY: 'Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Camping Rates Available'; reviews: 2021-12-17 'They are permanent (long term) residents.'; 2024-12-17 'Many full time, older RVs to one side'; 2024-06-23 'some seem to be longer term'; 2018 'mostly people that have been here awhile ... most sites looked really "lived in."' (a search summary also attributes '90% full-timers' to a 2023 review, which I did not read myself). Nightly guests are not discouraged and there is no posted minimum; the nightly share could not be measured (sites are under canopy). With the $55 report this looks mostly-seasonal and borderline on price - a reviewer call, not an outright drop. Google 4.5 (241) is good.
SITES: count 70 (note-derived) not confirmed; neither site gives a count. Left unchanged.

WEBSITE: the stored https://www.whisperingoakscampgroundtn.com/ is live (2024 Wix rebuild); Google links the older https://whisperingoaks37355.wixsite.com/atwhisperingwoods, also live and the only one carrying the amenity list and 'Open All Year Round'. Optional: add it as website line 2.
